archive.hashScope: header and directory tree; excludes payload and checksum/signature sections

versionObservation.qualification: Contemporaneous installed version metadata; not a cryptographic binding of that version to the VPK or help payload.

qualifications: Facts are concise original interpretations; the complete Valve help asset is not redistributed.
Exact case-sensitive tokens are retained. No historical class-name aliases are inferred.
Source text hashes and line spans identify the native help passages; requery the original asset to audit the full wording.
Each sourceTextSha256 hashes the unquoted, KeyValues-unescaped string value encoded as UTF-8, preserving the original CRLF characters. Normalizing newlines changes multiline passage hashes.
These facts do not establish compilation, retained KV3 properties, algorithms, runtime outputs or rendered pixels.
